# GiveAid — Design Notes

## Replication Source

- ColorLib "Adopted": https://colorlib.com/wp/template/adopted/
- Preview: https://preview.colorlib.com/theme/adopted/
- Screenshot: https://colorlib.com/wp/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/adopted-free-template.jpg

## Tokens Extracted

- Brand: #bc5148 (warm coral)
- CTA gold: #f4b214
- Top bar: #dee2e6
- Body text: #868e96
- Footer bg: #bc5148
- Font: Open Sans + Sacramento (Google Fonts)

## Differences from Original

- Name: "GiveAid" (not "Adopted")
- No ColorLib references in app code
- Footer links to Component Dock
- Placeholder images via picsum.photos
- SVG illustration replaced with lucide-react icons or custom SVG
- Bootstrap grid replaced with Tailwind CSS
